title: Steve harvey script decal spam and Sound
features: Decal spam and sound Not fe
script:
Spooky = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
Spooky.Name = "Spooky"
Spooky.SoundId = "rbxassetid://98487554542424"
Spooky.Volume = 10000
Spooky.Looped = true
Spooky.Pitch = 0.1
Spooky:Play()
decalID = 80817550141022
function exPro(root)
	for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID then
			v.Parent = nil
		elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.Material = "Plastic"
			v.Transparency = 0

			local faces = {"Front", "Back", "Right", "Left", "Top", "Bottom"}
			for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				decal.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID
				decal.Face = face
			end
		end
		exPro(v)
	end
end

function asdf(root)
	for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		asdf(v)
	end
end

exPro(game.Workspace)
asdf(game.Workspace)
